tasks.title: Rust: WsEvent enum + set_event_sink/emit push channel in wo-renderer-wasm
tasks.description: The WsEvent enum lives in a NEW module core/crates/wo-renderer-wasm/src/events.rs (create it; the crate uses `mod events;` in lib.rs). The ORM-02 map (plan/oo-port/wasm-events.md §4) already specifies the full enum — reuse it verbatim (money): `#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)] #[serde(tag = "event", content = "payload", rename_all = "snake_case")] pub enum WsEvent { SelectionEnd, SelectionChanged { rects: Vec<Rect>, cursor: Option<Pos> }, FocusObject { kind: String }, ToolbarState { bold: Option<bool>, italic: Option<bool>, underline: Option<bool>, strikeout: Option<bool>, font_size: Option<f64>, font_family: Option<String>, para_style: Option<String>, align: Option<String>, vertical_align: Option<String>, text_color: Option<String> }, ZoomChanged { scale: f64 }, CurrentPage { page: u32, visible_pages: Vec<u32>, count_pages: u32 }, DocumentContentReady { pages: u32 }, DocumentModifiedChanged { modified: bool }, CanUndoRedo { undo: bool, redo: bool }, Error { code: i32, message: String }, LongAction { begin: bool, id: String, text: String }, DownloadUrl { url: String }, CoAuthoringDisconnect { reason: String }, AuthParticipantsChanged { users: Vec<Collaborator> }, ForeignCursor { show: bool, user_id: String, label: String, pos: Option<Pos> }, LockDocumentProps { locked: bool, user_id: Option<String> }, TrackRevisionsChange { on: bool }, AddComment { id: String, data: Value }, RemoveComment { id: String }, UpdateCommentPosition { id: String, rects: Vec<Rect> }, SpellCheckVariants { word: String, variants: Vec<String>, lang: String }, TextLanguage { lang: String }, UpdateScrolls { h: ScrollState, v: ScrollState }, ContextMenu { screen: Pos, on_object: bool }, PluginEvent { guid: String, data: Value }, Other { name: String, data: Value } }` plus the structs Pos/Rect/ScrollState/Collaborator. Wire shape per the map: externally tagged; the frame object editor.js receives is `{ "event": "<snake_case_variant>", "payload": {...} }`. ADD the binding plumbing in events.rs: `pub type JsEventSink = js_sys::Function; thread_local! { static SINK: RefCell<Option<JsEventSink>> }`; `#[wasm_bindgen] pub fn set_event_sink(cb: Option<js_sys::Function>)` (with an initial `notifyHost` back-compat fallback if cb is None), `#[wasm_bindgen] pub fn emit_event(evt: JsValue)` (deserialize JSON into WsEvent and invoke the sink), and a Rust-side `pub fn push(evt: &WsEvent)` used by the rest of the engine to enqueue. Unit tests (in events_tests.rs, plain #[test] with serde only — no wasm needed): serialization of each priority variant matches the expected `{"event":...}` JSON shape; `Other { name, data }` round-trips arbitrary payloads. After implementation run `cargo test -p wo-renderer-wasm --lib` — must stay green (current baseline 153 passing).
tasks.acceptance: cargo test -p wo-renderer-wasm --lib passes (baseline 153 tests stay green + new events tests pass); events.rs defines WsEvent with all variants from the ORM-02 §4 spec; set_event_sink + emit_event wasm exports exist; a plain #[test] proves at least 3 priority frames serialize to the expected externally-tagged JSON shape.
tasks.accept: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && test -f core/crates/wo-renderer-wasm/src/events.rs && grep -qE 'pub enum WsEvent' core/crates/wo-renderer-wasm/src/events.rs && grep -qE 'set_event_sink|emit_event' core/crates/wo-renderer-wasm/src/events.rs && grep -q 'mod events' core/crates/wo-renderer-wasm/src/lib.rs && timeout 550 cargo test -p wo-renderer-wasm --lib 2>&1 | grep -q 'test result: ok' && wc -l core/crates/wo-renderer-wasm/src/events.rs

tasks.title: Rust: props module — Wasm* serde property-blob structs + set_property/get_property
tasks.description: Create NEW module core/crates/wo-renderer-wasm/src/props.rs (`mod props;` in lib.rs). This is ORM-03 §6 + PORT-PLAN Phase 1 item 2 — the ~25 Wasm* serde structs that reproduce OO's asc_C* wire schema with camelCase keys so the OO UI can bind without a translation layer. Scope the work to the WORD-relevant families only (the maps mark spreadsheet/form-field/chart/pdf-annotation as later phases): paragraph (asc_CParagraphProperty, asc_CParagraphShd, asc_CParagraphSpacing, asc_CParagraphFrame), border (asc_CBorder, asc_CBorders, asc_CTextBorder), run-format (asc_CTextFontFamily), page-setup (asc_CPageMargins, asc_CPageOptions, asc_CPageSetup), list-bullet (asc_CBullet, asc_CCustomListType, asc_CListType), color (asc_CColor), style (asc_CStyle), comment (asc_CCommentData, asc_CCommentDataWord), collab (asc_CUserInfo, asc_CVersionHistory). For each: `#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)] #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")] pub struct WasmX { ... }` with field names/semantics taken from the `properties` arrays in plan/oo-port/wasm-data-classes.json (read them — verted facts, do not invent). Where wo-ooxml model types already carry the same fields (e.g. DocxBorder from wo-ooxml/src/model.rs), provide a From conversion rather than a parallel struct (ORT: reuse `wo_ooxml::model` types). Add two #[wasm_bindgen] exports in props.rs: `pub fn set_property(kind: &str, json: &str) -> Result<(), JsError>` and `pub fn get_property(kind: &str, json: &str) -> Result<String, JsError>` — kind is the case-insensitive class name minus prefix (e.g. "paragraph_property", "ctext_border", "ccolor"), splitting at the first non-alnum; round-trips through serde_json; unknown kinds return Err with the supported list. Unit tests (props_tests.rs, plain #[test], serde only): each struct serializes to camelCase keys; round-trip of a representative sample per family; set_property/get_property round-trip through the JSON boundary; From<WasmBorder> for DocxBorder compiles and maps every field. Run `cargo test -p wo-renderer-wasm --lib` — must stay green (baseline 153).
tasks.acceptance: cargo test -p wo-renderer-wasm --lib passes; props.rs defines the word-family Wasm* structs (paragraph/border/run-format/page-setup/list/color/style/comment/collab), camelCase serde, set_property/get_property exports round-trip through JSON; plain #[test]s cover each family.

tasks.title: Rust: session/lifecycle exports — identity, doc-info, coAuthoringDisconnect event

This is the document-session block: identity and document-info metadata. Implement as a thread_local! tasks.title: JS: WsEvent frame dispatcher + engineEventsSink seam in editor.js
tasks.description: PORT-PLAN Phase 1 item 1 (D1, second half): the editor.js consumer of the WsEvent frames. In apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg/editor.js there are 79 `notifyHost` call sites and a `wo-command` CustomEvent bus (window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("wo-command", {detail:{command,...}})) around line 4540) — this is the established plumbing. Add a small `wsEventDispatcher` that consumes an incoming frame object `{event, payload}` and: (1) for known events fires a specific CustomEvent on window: `wo-event` with detail {event, payload, at: Date.now()} always, plus named events `wo-event:<snake_name>` for editor.js's own internal listeners (e.g. selection-end, document-modified-changed, zoom-changed — name them as snake_case of the event field); (2) fans out unknown frames as `wo-event` with the raw detail (WsEvent::Other survives 1:1). Wire a stub `engineEventsSink(frame)` function that is a no-op today but is the exact seam where the wasm `set_event_sink` callback will attach (place it next to the dispatcher with a clear comment). Also add the two new event bus constants for the priority frames (asc_onCoAuthoringDisconnect -> co_authoring_disconnect, asc_onDocumentModifiedChanged -> document_modified_changed) to whatever registry maps on* names (search editor.js for any asc_ naming map; if none exists, add a small const map). CRITICAL GUARDRAIL: do NOT refactor or reformat editor.js beyond adding the dispatcher block and constants; do not touch event names used by existing tests (wo-command, ctx-menu, wo:chart-settings, wo:print-selection, wo:keep-lines, odt-persisted, lists-persisted, images-persisted, wo-open-file). Deliver a NEW test file apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg/wasm-events.test.mjs using node:test + node:assert (plain Node, zero deps — match the style of ctx-menu.test.mjs in the same dir): (a) extract the dispatcher source from editor.js and assert it builds the `wo-event` CustomEvent with {event, payload}; (b) assert the 15 priority frame names map correctly (asc_onX -> snake field); (c) assert unknown frames route to the wo-event fallback. Run: `cd apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg && /usr/bin/node --test wasm-events.test.mjs` — must pass. Also add the stub `engineEventsSink` must be findable via a test-side regex. Do not modify any existing test file.
tasks.acceptance: apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg/wasm-events.test.mjs passes via `node --test`; editor.js has wsEventDispatcher handling wo-event dispatch + named wo-event:<snake> events + engineEventsSink seam; 15 priority frame name map present; existing editor.js CustomEvent names untouched.
tasks.accept: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && test -f apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg/wasm-events.test.mjs && cd apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg && /usr/bin/node --test wasm-events.test.mjs 2>&1 | tail -3 | grep -q 'pass 1\|tests 1\|# pass' && grep -qE 'wsEventDispatcher|engineEventsSink' editor.js && grep -qE 'co_authoring_disconnect|document_modified_changed' editor.js
